<div class="card-body">
'''I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ウーキーとキスする方がましだわ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手がカードを配備した直後に使用する。３フォース消費してそのカードを相手の手札に戻させる。そのカードを配備するのに消費したフォースは消費されたままとなる。次の相手のターンに、そのカードは不可能でない限り、必ず同じロケーションに配備されなければならない。この際、配備にフォースは消費しない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ESB-Two-Player-Id-Just-As-Soon-Kiss-A-Wookiee-SWCA-100675.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「まあせいぜい楽しみな。お熱いやつをな」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after the opponent deploys a card. Spend 3 Force to return that card to the opponent's hand. Force spent to deploy that card remains spent. On the opponent's next turn, that card must be deployed to the same location if possible. That deployment costs no Force.

'''Lore:'''
“Well, enjoy yourself as much as you like. A hot one.”

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Lore is Han’s line about enjoying a hot kiss, not English “I can arrange that.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[I'd Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee]] in [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 45, 106. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
